about_the_game:
** Scavenger T.O.M is in development. Wishlist and follow to stay updated—thank you for your support!


The Surface is Dead, But Survival Continues

After a nuclear apocalypse, civilization has collapsed.
The surface, now filled with deadly radiation, appears devoid of life.
Humanity has retreated into underground bunkers, and the fight for survival has begun.

You Are One of the Survivors

You’ve endured life in the bunker for years, but your food supplies are running out. Your resources are dwindling.
Yet, venturing to the surface means certain death—the radiation is too intense.
To survive, you need something, or someone, to explore in your place.

Meet T.O.M.

Once a simple household robot, now your only explorer and last hope.
With a remote controller in hand, you must guide T.O.M. from the depths of your bunker to the ruins of a lost world.
Scour the ruins for supplies, strengthen your shelter, and carve a path to survival.

But beware—something unexpected may still be lurking in the ruins.
Can T.O.M. uncover hope on the surface? 

 Explore the ruins with T.O.M. 

The surface is no longer the place you once knew.
A radioactive city, crumbling skyscrapers, rusted machines 
Everything has changed since humanity abandoned it.

Take control of T.O.M., your robotic companion, and navigate through the remnants of civilization.
Scan contaminated zones, map out safe routes, and uncover forgotten technology.

Hack into abandoned facilities and restore lost knowledge.
Find ways to survive midst of radioactive storms and desolate wastelands.

Gather Resources, Craft Your Future

Exploration isn’t just an adventure—it’s a necessity for survival.
Collect materials from the ruins and use them to craft tools, upgrade your shelter, and refine essential supplies.
Produce water, food, and energy to sustain life in the depths below.

The further you explore, the more advanced your survival technology becomes, and the better your chances of survival.

Upgrade T.O.M. and Overcome the Dangers

The ruins hold more than just remnants of the past—there may be hidden threats.
Upgrade T.O.M., enhance its exploration gear, and improve its survival capabilities.

Even in the hostile environment, you must gather data and expand your reach.
 Explore the ruins and shape the future of your bunker, with T.O.M.

Craft Your Sanctuary

The world may be in ruins, but hope isn’t lost.
Gather resources and craft essential tools to withstand radiation and strengthen your bunker’s defenses.

Refine materials, engineer survival gear, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten civilization.

The Surface is Ruined, but Hope Remains

The surface has become a wasteland, but hope still remains.
Even if that hope seems small now, you must seek it out with T.O.M. and nurture it into something greater.
At times, you may stumble upon unexpected moments of beauty on the surface.
There could be other survivors besides you, or you might even discover a single blooming flower.

The world is broken, but we are still alive.
Explore ruins, Craft to survive.

short_description: Scavenger T.O.M is a survival crafting game set in a radiation-contaminated world. Use your exploration robot, T.O.M, to gather resources, craft tools, and survive. With radiation spreading, efficient resource management is key. Plan expeditions strategically and craft wisely to stay alive
